title: PlanB's November target
lede: On 1 November 2021 PlanB posted a target of more than $98K for Bitcoin in November. Two days later Eric bet a cube that it would fail, and Adam Back took the bet 18 minutes later. Eric unveiled the cube on 28 December as piece #1 of his collection.

terms.quote: Next targets: Nov>$98K, Dec>$135K
I’m willing to bet a 1.5” tungsten cube this Nov prediction fails. Any takers?
i'll take a tungsten cube. sounds like fun.

terms.pre: The November target only. Not the December target of more than $135K, and not PlanB's model as a whole.

terms.quote: he lost the bet on whether PlanB’s (@100trillionUSD) floor model would fail to meet its >$98K November target (it failed).
i had no opinions on the floor model. fwiw
terms.after: He took the bet, not a side on the model.

log.detail: Eric says PlanB's November target fails; Adam takes the other side
the first cube in the collection

title: The Merge in 2022
lede: In May 2022 Eric asked for a notable bitcoiner to bet him that the Merge, Ethereum's switch to proof of stake, would not happen that year. Christian Keroles of Bitcoin Magazine took the bet. On 30 December 2022 Eric scored it: the Merge had happened, and Keroles had lost a cube.

terms.quote: Can I get a notable bitcoiner to bet me a 1.5” tungsten cube (~$400) that the Merge (Ethereum successfully switching to PoS) won’t happen this year?
I’ll bet you.
Bet is on whether Ethereum will successfully migrate to PoS or not in 2022. I am taking the ”pro” side, @ck_SNARKs is taking the ”con”.

terms.pre: Eric had already said what a successful Merge looks like, in a prediction on 29 Dec 2021:
terms.quote: Yes, the Merge will happen and it will be successful. There may be some resistance from PoW miners, but any remaining PoW-chainsplit of Ethereum will swiftly fall into irrelevance. No catastrophic attacks on ETH2 PoS occur.
terms.after: The bet post did not repeat these conditions.

terms.quote: The fact that the Merge happened without any bugs, emergency fixes or need to restart despite so many different clients interacting with each other is one of the bright spots of the year. ETHPoW became a thing but did become irrelevant. @ck_SNARKs lost a tungsten cube

log.detail: Eric says the Merge happens in 2022; Keroles says it does not

log.excerpt: […] 2022 I won a tungsten cube from Christian Keroles (Managing Director at Bitcoin Magazine) over the Merge. […]

title: ETH withdrawals in 2023
lede: In September 2022 Eric offered a cube on Ethereum enabling withdrawals in 2023. @bitcoinerrrrr took the other side in November. By March 2023 he wrote that he knew he had lost, and the cube arrived on 26 May 2023.

terms.quote: Tungsten bet offer: ETH withdrawals will be enabled in 2023 / Me: Yes, it will happen / You: No, it won’t happen
Hey stop taking candy from babies. How about your other bet, still taking people on that? I'll take that

terms.pre: Withdrawals enabled in 2023, or not. Nothing about amounts, or when in the year.

terms.quote: after I entered the bet I started following tweets from @TimBeiko and immediately knew I pretty much lost the bet
A new tungsten cube arrived today! This shoutout goes to @bitcoinerrrrr for betting me that ETH withdrawals wouldn’t launch this year.

log.detail: Eric says withdrawals are enabled in 2023; @bitcoinerrrrr says they are not

log.excerpt: […] 2023 I plan to win against @bitcoinerrrrr over ETH withdrawals.

title: ETH to $500
lede: In May 2022 Brad Mills said ETH was going back to $500, and took Eric's bet on it, though not for a cube. In November, after saying 2023 would be “absolute capitulation” for DeFi, he made the stake a cube. In January 2023 Eric softened the terms by adding a second phase. Brad lost the first phase at the end of 2023 and paid for the cube. The second phase ran to about June 2024.

terms.quote: Yes I want the bet! / I don't want a cube though...
You can come up with what you want later of equal value, bet accepted
ETH to $500 or I owe Eric a tungsten cube. If he's wrong he owes me one.
Here’s a compromise I’ll offer: If ETH does not drop below $500 in this year, you send me the cube. If it drops below $500 after that but before June 2024, I’ll send you the cube back.
Today I lost phase 1 of my bet with @ercwl. I was calling ETH to $500 and it only dropped to like $890.
Phase 2 of our bet expires ~June 2024. If ETH hasn't dropped by $500 by then, Eric keeps the cube. If it has, he sends it back to me.

log.excerpt: I keep saying that ETH is going back to $500. […]

title: WBTC in 2023
lede: In November 2022 Eric bet his whole collection that WBTC and WETH would not fail in 2023, against one cube from anyone who took the bet. @Midas1crypto took WBTC only. He paid on 31 December 2023, and Eric added the cube on 15 January 2024.

terms.quote: betting my entire tungsten cube collection that WBTC and WETH won’t fail / shoot your shot. / bet settles end of 2023 and you only pay one tungsten cube if you lose
Cute.."and weth".. just do wbtc and I'm in

terms.pre: Uneven: Eric's whole collection against one cube from Midas.
WBTC alone, by the end of 2023. WETH was dropped when Midas took the bet. Neither side put a number on “fail”: no size of depeg, no custody halt, no length of time.

terms.quote: Even if your bet that WBTC would fail in 2023 did not hold up, your honor remains intact.

log.detail: Eric says WBTC does not fail in 2023; Midas says it does
